answer_1.quote: Grounded dialogue modeling... operates on existing responses... Our goal is to minimally edit r_o such that it is grounded on the concept g and coherent with the dialogue history c.
answer_1.outputs: Edited responses (r_e) generated by the grounded minimal editor

answer_2.quote: We compute BLEU-4 score based on the collected multiple human references... We define P-Score to evaluate the persona consistency... We also report BLEU, F1, and NLL evaluated by GPT-2.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 150 test samples for human evaluation... Three annotators are hired to vote... We instruct annotators to evaluate knowledge, empathy, persona consistency, and grammaticality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer four questions: Knowledge (0/1), Empathy (0/1), Background occurrences (persona consistency), Grammaticality (0/1). Preference voting between system outputs is also collected.
